contexts.text: Hence it is evident what is signified by... the keys with which is opened (the door of Heaven).
Preface [2]. To this faith belong the keys of the Kingdom of the Heavens...
That Pope spoke to me... about Peter and his keys, which he supposed himself to have... He was instructed what is meant by Peter's keys, namely, the faith of love and of charity... SE 3648.
I will give thee the keys of the Kingdom of the Heavens ()... By the rock, here, ... is signified the faith of charity... and thus the keys to open and shut Heaven are given to this faith.
By the key () is meant the power.
That keys = power. Illustrated.
One Angel prevails against a thousand who are from the Hells. It is this power which is meant by the keys of Peter...
I spoke with some from that nation concerning the keys given to Peter...
The knowledge of degrees is like a key to open the causes of things.

I have the keys of Hell and of death () = that He alone can save... The reason to have the keys of Hell and of death does not mean the power to cast into Hell, but the power to save. Explained. AE 86.
By the keys is signified the power to open and shut. Illustrated.

He who hath the key of David, and who openeth and no one shutteth, and shutteth and no one openeth () = who alone has omnipotence to save. By David is meant the Lord as to Divine truth. By the key is signified the Lord's omnipotence over Heaven and Hell...
The like is meant by the key of David given to Eliakim ().
There was given to him the key of the pit of the abyss () = their Hell open. By a key is signified the power to open, and also the act of opening. References.
What the Lord said to Peter about the keys of the Kingdom of the Heavens. Explained.

By the keys of the Kingdom of the Heavens, which are that whatever that Rock, which is the Lord, shall bind on earth shall be bound in the Heavens, and that whatever it shall loose on earth shall be loosed in the Heavens, is meant that the Lord has the power over Heaven and earth... thus the power to save the men who from faith of the heart are in that confession of Peter.
To have the key of the abyss () = the Divine power to open and shut Hell.
He handed me the key, and said, Write.
Not even to look through the key hole.
The Holy Supper... is like the key to their house in Heaven.

By Peter is meant faith, and to faith are given the keys of the Lord's Kingdom; because no one can be admitted into Heaven except by faith in the Lord, and no one gives faith except the Lord; therefore the Lord alone has the keys of the Heavens...
(The English) give keys to strangers, which are signs that they would be received.
He came to those who said that they have Peter's keys...

The reason keys are mentioned, is that all the Hells are closed, and are opened only when evil Spirits are cast in, and when some are taken out... Hence keys are mentioned, by which is signified the power to open and to shut... The like is signified by the keys given to Peter...

He who hath the key of David = Who has power by Divine truth. A key = the power to open and to shut; here, Heaven and Hell... Hence by a key is here meant the power to save; because to open Heaven and to close Hell is to save.
The like is meant by the key of Peter as by the key of David; namely, that the Lord has all the power; and that He has Power by His Divine truth. AE 206:3.

This is also meant by the keys given to Peter; for by Peter there... is meant truth from good which is from the Lord, thus faith from charity; and by the keys given to him is meant power over evils and falsities. AE 411:15.
There was given to him the key of the pit of the abyss = communication and conjunction with the Hells. A key = the act of opening. AE 536:2, Explained.
A key (as used in the Spiritual World) corresponds to admission and opening from one part (of the mind) into another.
From these things it may be known whence it is that a key is mentioned; and that it = admission and opening. Illustrated.
Therefore it is said that they carry the keys of Heaven (); that is, that by truths they can open communication with Heaven for those whom they teach...
By the keys of the Kingdom of the Heavens is signified intromission into Heaven for all those who are in truths from good from the Lord.
The reason the keys of the Kingdom of the Heavens were given to Peter, is that he represented the Lord as to Divine truth.
